outcome: reduction of infants requiring ROP screening
cohort: A monocentric cohort of 475 Italian preterm infants (from an initial 595 evaluated) born between May 2015 and July 2020 with known birth weight, gestational age, serial weight measurement, and ROP outcome.
finding: The G-ROP screening criteria demonstrated 100% sensitivity and specificity for detecting type 1 ROP and treated ROP, and could reduce eye examinations by 29% for preterm infants.
